# A round bush: three faceted balls, squashed. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Leaf --base-color 0.1176 0.5333 0.4588 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name B1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.75 --location 0 0 0.55
add mesh ico-sphere --name B2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.55 --location 0.7 0.1 0.4
add mesh ico-sphere --name B3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location -0.65 -0.05 0.38
select B1 B2 B3
active B1
join
rename B1 Bush
material assign Leaf
scale 1 1 0.85
apply --scale
select all
shade flat
export bush.glb
